purpose: A verbatim transcription of one independent study, so the served lettuce model can be held against data it was never trained on. Every number here is copied from the cited publication; nothing is estimated, averaged or reconstructed.
transcribedBy: manual copy from the publisher's open-access full text; no parsing of plots or figures

source.title: Vertical farming for lettuce production in limited space: a case study in Northern Thailand
source.sha256Note: Hash of the JATS XML response as received on that date. It identifies the copy transcribed here, not the publisher's canonical file; a re-fetch may differ in whitespace.
source.figuresUsed: none — no value was read off a figure

studyConditions.location: Hang Dong district, Chiang Mai province, Thailand
studyConditions.system: greenhouse, six shelves, three levels each (upper, middle, lower), 0.6 m between levels
studyConditions.growingMedium: growing bags, 7 kg of topsoil:chicken manure:coconut husk:rice husk ash:rice husk 2:1:1:1:1 by volume, drip irrigation twice daily

quotes.conditions: The average temperature was 27.5 ± 8.3 °C, and the relative humidity was 62.4 ± 27.6%
quotes.levels: the upper level (PPFD 697 μmol m−2 s−1 and DLI 29 mol m−2 d−1) in comparison to the middle (PPFD 391 μmol m−2 s−1 and DLI 16 mol m−2 d−1) and lower (PPFD 322 μmol m−2 s−1 and DLI 13 mol m−2 d−1) levels
quotes.harvest: At maturity (28 DAT), the fresh weight (FW) of ‘Green Oak’ and ‘Baby Cos’ was weighted directly after harvesting

table1Verbatim.caption: Mean values and standard deviation (SD) of fresh and dry yields as well as LUE of BC (‘Baby Cos’) and GO (‘Green Oak’) at 28 DAT.
table1Verbatim.note: Superscript letters are the publication's own significance groups (Tukey); rows other than fresh yield are omitted from the transcription.

acceptedAssumptions.value: set equal to the study's measured air temperature (27.5 °C)
acceptedAssumptions.why: The publication reports air temperature and relative humidity but not root-zone or growing-media temperature. The model requires a root temperature input, so it is assumed equal to air temperature, which is plausible for growing bags inside a greenhouse but is an assumption and is labelled as one.

notUsed: The paper's per-area comparison of 6.34 kg m−2 (vertical) against 2.11 kg m−2 (horizontal) is recorded but not scored: the model predicts per-plant mass, and converting it to per-area would require a density the model was not trained on.
Cumulative DLI values (807 / 438 / 360 mol m−2) are recorded verbatim but not passed to the model, which takes instantaneous PPFD.
